name: Fly Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells over your chest with a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms wide in a fly until you feel a chest stretch.
As you bring the dumbbells back, rotate into a press by bending the elbows and driving them together.
Finish with the dumbbells locked out over your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A hybrid dumbbell movement that begins as a fly to stretch the chest and finishes as a press.
